environment: Owned headless Google Chrome against a local VibeScope Python server; actual analysis endpoints, no mocked measurements.
browser_checks_passed: Native HTML form validity for the default synthetic demonstration
Actual original-frame measurement response and synthetic-source labeling
Original and enhanced H264 playback with shared controls and timeline seek
Signal CSV, quantitative plot and report JSON returned real artifacts
Reference JSON import and explicit acquisition-match confirmation gate
Actual reference scoring reports diagnostic=false and user-declared setup match
Changing the acquisition axis clears reference confirmation
Loading a new source clears prior physical scale and free-ringdown declaration
390px mobile page has no horizontal overflow
Invalid frequency-band feedback is visible and results are not fabricated

demonstration_video.description: Trimmed actual browser capture of the completed workspace: synchronized playback, waveform inspection, artifact export and acquisition limitations. The specimen video is controlled synthetic motion.

limitations: Functional browser evidence does not establish real-world displacement accuracy, resonance identification or machine diagnostic reliability.
The physical specimen and healthy-reference signals in these checks are synthetic; no independently measured real machine was used.
